The child blocks on read and the parent on wait(), so the step is killed by its 3-minute timeout; last -v line 'tests/test_app.py::test_expected_routes_registered' after 1 PASSED, no summary. Why a pipe: in GitHub Actions a step's own stdin is not interactive, so input() or a direct read there gets end-of-file and fails fast, and pytest's capture makes a test's stdin read raise at once. Only a pipe whose write end stays open blocks, and that is the realistic bug (a forgotten close()). Verify locally with a short timeout.
